content.introduction:
Yahoo Finance’s tech section reports a US polysilicon price floor and tariffs to counter China, Rocket Lab’s $8 billion Iridium acquisition, a $116 million Bitcoin wallet hack, and SpaceX’s first earnings preview.  
It also covers Apple’s MacBook Air stock shortage, EU AI rule scrutiny, Samsung TV app data‑sharing, and a $130 million phishing surge affecting hardware wallets.  
These stories highlight supply‑chain, regulatory, and security issues in technology.
